subject: Trial packaging anchor and concession request
messages:
From: Derek Holt <derek.holt@pinebrook.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Short trial ask — anchored pricing for a 6-week evaluation

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the model latency and throughput numbers looked promising for our ingestion workload. We want to run a short, time-boxed evaluation to validate integration effort and cost before committing to a production rollout.

High-level ask: a 6-week trial starting mid-September. A couple of constraints on our side:
- We need predictable unit economics for the evaluation so engineering can plan resource usage.
- Procurement will require a one-line concession or anchor on price for the trial window (so they can justify spend to the CFO).

Would Redwood consider either: (A) a fixed token bucket for the 6 weeks with a capped overage rate, or (B) a per-request timebox with a short runway extension clause if we hit an integration blocker? We're open to a conditional discount if we convert to a paid plan within 90 days.

I attached a brief list of evaluation goals and an estimated usage profile. Also looping procurement when we get pricing specifics.

Thanks,
Derek
Derek Holt
Head of ML Engineering, Pinebrook Labs
derek.holt@pinebrook.ai
Attachment: pilot_scope.pdf (1.2 MB, PDF)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Derek Holt <derek.holt@pinebrook.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short trial ask — anchored pricing for a 6-week evaluation

Derek — great to hear the demo landed. Appreciate the clear goals in your doc.

We can do a few pragmatic options — want to surface them quickly so procurement has something concrete:

Option 1 — Fixed evaluation bucket
- 6-week fixed token bucket sized to your forecast (we'll size after your XLS).
- One capped overage rate (2x standard hosted rate) so costs are predictable.
- No extra charge for one operational review call per week.

Option 2 — Timebox runway + surge protection
- We measure tokens/requests daily; if you exceed the forecast by >20% for 3 consecutive days, we trigger a temporary surge cap (prevent runaway bills).
- Engineering support hours billed separately unless you convert.

Concession we can offer: a conversion discount ladder if you convert to a committed plan after the trial —
- Convert within 60 days: 18% off list for first 6 months
- Convert within 90 days: 12% off list for first 6 months
- No conversion within 90 days: standard list applies

Two practical asks from our side before we finalize:
1) Can you send a simple usage_forecast.xlsx (token/day by endpoint) — will use to size the bucket?
2) Confirm the top success criteria (latency SLO, throughput, failure rates) so we can scope the SOW.

If that looks reasonable I can loop Dev (finance/pricing) and Laura (legal) to draft a short addendum and a proposed SOW stub.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Derek Holt <derek.holt@pinebrook.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure <procure@pinebrook.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 18:20:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Short trial ask — anchored pricing for a 6-week evaluation

Marissa — thanks for the clear options. Attached is the usage_forecast.xlsx you requested. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/engineering:

- Procurement asked whether the conversion ladder could be front-loaded (e.g., 20% if we convert within 45 days) — they need a stronger incentive to move quickly. Is that something Redwood can entertain?
- Engineering asked for a one-time 2-week runway extension (free) in case we hit a blocker that delays validation; that keeps the evaluation honest without blowing the budget.
- Also want a short clause that if we exceed the bucket by >100% due to production traffic, you let us cap and pause rather than auto-bill — we need to avoid surprise invoices while we fix integration.

We're aiming to start the trial around Sep 15. Happy to take a short call tomorrow to align.

Thanks,
Derek
Attachment: usage_forecast.xlsx (small)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Derek Holt <derek.holt@pinebrook.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Sep 2027 02:45:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Short trial ask — anchored pricing for a 6-week evaluation

Derek — looping in pricing/finance (Dev), legal (Laura) and pricing authority (Rishi) to confirm final wording. Quick summary and what we can do right now: 

1) Incentive ladder
- We can accelerate to a 20% conversion discount if Pinebrook commits to a signed 12-month reserved capacity agreement within 45 days of trial completion (requires simple signature; we will reflect this in the addendum).
- If conversion occurs between day 46–90, discount steps to 12% for the first 6 months.

2) Runway extension
- We will include a one-time 2-week evaluation extension at no additional charge if Pinebrook provides the usage forecast and a short blocker report (engineering notes / ticket) explaining the delay. This will be captured in the SOW stub.

3) Overages / cap behavior
- For the trial only we will set an automatic hold threshold at 100% over the agreed bucket. If you exceed that threshold, we will pause ingestion and notify the account team and your engineering contact. We will not auto-bill beyond the capped overage without explicit approval.

Next steps (what I need from you to finalize the addendum):
- Confirm acceptance of the 20%/12% ladder and the 2-week extension terms above.
- Sign a one-page evaluation addendum once we share it (Laura will keep it short).
- We'll attach the proposed SOW stub (low-touch integration + monitoring + 3 engineering touchpoints).

Attaching a short SOW stub and will draft an addendum this week. If you want the 20% to be unconditional we need a small upfront PO to hold capacity — happy to discuss.

Thanks — will get legal draft to you tomorrow.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed_sow_stub.pdf (PDF)
